messages:
Sam: Heads-up — planning an infra apply for the tenant-vpc split tonight at 22:00 UTC. Need deploybot pin, a short quiet window (~30m) and an explicit rollback plan. :eyes:
Aisha: Ack. I'll add a short blurb to release notes & link the runbook. Which modules are changing?
Sam: network/vpc, network/route53, iam/service-accounts. No DB changes.
Marco: What's the IAM change surface? any SA rotation or new cross-account roles?
Sam: Adding a new tenant-bouncer SA and a restricted cross-account role for monitoring. No mass rotation. We do create a new service account and attach role via terraform.
Priya: We should prepare an ephemeral-cred fallback — if the SA fails to be provisioned we should fallback to existing monitoring role with least privilege.
Sam: Agreed. Plan: canary apply to staging 21:15 UTC, dry-run logs posted, then main at 22:00. If any SA creation fails, abort and roll back network change only (leave route53 alone) and open an incident.
Aisha: I'll add a release-note annotation: "tenant-vpc split — canary in staging, main apply 22:00 UTC, ephemeral-iam fallback prepared".
deploybot: Request created: id=rb-20240328-72, preflight plans uploaded. Triggered dry-run at 21:15. See https://deploys.example.com/rb-20240328-72 :thumbsup:
Sam: deploybot, pin this change to window 22:00-22:30 UTC and suppress auto-merge. Also set deploybot-override=false.
deploybot: Pin applied to window 22:00-22:30 UTC. Auto-merge suppressed. CI checks: 8/8 passed.
Marco: Can we get the exact terraform plan summary in the channel once dry-run completes? any potential destructive actions?
deploybot: Dry-run summary uploaded. Change summary: +3 resources, ~2 changes to IAM bindings, no destroy operations. Full plan: https://plans.example.com/rb-20240328-72/plan.txt
Sam: Copying plan snippet here:
```
# network/vpc: create aws_vpc.tenant_vpc
+ aws_vpc.tenant_vpc
# iam/service-accounts: create google_service_account.tenant_bouncer
+ google_service_account.tenant_bouncer
# iam/bindings: update google_project_iam_binding.monitoring
~ google_project_iam_binding.monitoring (1 attr changed)
```
Priya: Good. Make sure ops duty has a manual rollback ticket template ready. If SA creation fails, rollback steps: 1) terraform apply -target=network/vpc -var='rollback=true' 2) revert route53 changes if DNS issues 3) escalate to security lead.
OpsDutyBot: Manual rollback template created: ticket TKT-4481, runbook link https://confluence.example.com/display/INF/tenant-vpc+rollback
Aisha: One more ask — add a release annotation to the canary with the commit hash and the short change-log line. I'll update the changelog after canary success.
Sam: Will attach commit sha: f3c2a9a and changelog text: "tenant-vpc split + tenant-bouncer SA (staged canary -> main)" to deploy metadata.
Marco: During apply, if IAM binding update takes >2m with retries, abort and run rollback for IAM only. We saw propagation flakiness last month.
Sam: Noted. Adding a preflight check: post-apply IAM binding verification script (2 retries, 30s apart). If verification fails, auto-flag for manual rollback.
Priya: Also ensure telemetry: per-route tokenized latency + failed SA create rate so we can quickly determine impact.
deploybot: Preflight hooks registered: iam-verify.sh, telemetry-hook. Canary schedule locked.
Aisha: I'll publish the release note draft in #release-notes and tag security for review.
Sam: Thanks everyone. I'll post quick runbook reminders 30m before main. :thumbsup:
